$comment: How lucide-animated's icons map onto Lucide's. Vendored files are in sources/animated/; run bun run icons:animated to update them, then bun run icons:audit. olderDrawings are icons that animate an older Lucide drawing, so at rest they differ from the outline icon; the audit keeps this list honest.
